note: Entity database. Each group is a BatteryGroup entity with aliases, dimensions, terminal, CCA (with its standard), and an evidence record. Values are cross-verified typical ranges, not a substitute for a specific battery's datasheet. Phase 2 Week 1 (2026-09-17) added 14 groups: H3, 22F, 63, 86, 27F, T5, T6, 60B19, 65B24, 85D23, 100D26, 105D31, 110D31, GC8.

evidence.basis: EN 50342-2 case codes (H3 = L0, EN code 32L0) + manufacturer datasheets
sources: EN 50342-2 reference tables (case codes L0–L6)
Manufacturer datasheets (Varta, Bosch, Banner, Exide)
evidence.note: Smallest standard EN/DIN case (L0, 175 mm long). Note: the EN case code "H3" (= L0) is distinct from manufacturer product-tier "H" labels (e.g. a Varta "H3" product is ~100 Ah); this entity refers to the EN 50342 case code. Typical values shown; the H3/L0 case is rated roughly 32–45 Ah by class.
